name: Puppy Park
description:
About This Game

Welcome to Puppy Park!

Nestled in a peaceful countryside setting, Puppy Park invites you to run your very own tiny dog hotel. Spend 20–30 minutes each day caring for adorable pups of all breeds and personalities, building bonds and growing your reputation one wagging tail at a time.

Daily Care & Connection

Every day, new dogs arrive with their unique natures and needs. Your job is to welcome them warmly — shop for the perfect food and treats, pamper them with grooming, and take them on walks along scenic routes tailored just for them.

Grow Your Hotel & Reputation

As word gets around about your excellent care facilities, your reputation will grow! Use this to unlock new items, expand your capabilities, and discover new walking routes to keep things fresh and exciting.

Relax and Enjoy the Simple Life

Designed for cozy, bite-sized daily play sessions, Puppy Park offers a soothing rhythm of care and connection. Watch your hotel fill with happy dogs, joyful barks, and wagging tails — a perfect little escape from the hustle and bustle.

What Puppy Park offers:

  • Manage a charming dog hotel with pups of all breeds and personalities

  • Engage in daily care loops: feeding, grooming, walking

  • Unlock new items and scenic walking routes as you grow your reputation

  • Relax with a slow-paced, real-time gameplay rhythm designed for short daily sessions

  • Enjoy peaceful countryside vibes and a cozy, heartwarming atmosphere

What Puppy Park does NOT offer:

  • Fast-paced or hardcore gameplay

  • Long play times (1hr+ per day)

  • Multiplayer or competitive modes

  • Complex hotel management and skill trees
short_desc: Run your very own Puppy Park — a tiny dog hotel for pups of every breed and personality! Feed them yummy snacks, pamper them with grooming, and embark on adventures. Earn their love, grow your reputation, and fill your hotel with wagging tails and happy barks! Play daily in bite-sized chunks!
